notes.title: Big Alliances update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/9086787a7305c56da083194cf193f9b3b62bcf65.png
We've got big news: We've given the Alliance system a major overhaul! And we're ready to tell you exactly what's changed. Let's get started!

Meet the Androids!
The Android is our latest addition to the game. The Android is your brand-new assistant which helps you out during your fights against other players on the Battlefield. Each Android has two abilities: one active and one passive. The active ability works one time per game at the beginning of the turn. Study all abilities and choose your Android wisely.

You can have up to three Androids in your squad at a time. Each Android has one of three tiers: R, SR, SSR. These determine the strength of the Android and how many resources it will take to upgrade it.

You can only obtain the Androids from Alliance activities. You will need to collect Encryption Keys, which can be purchased from the Heli Racing Market or the War Spoils. It usually contains Encryption Keys for two Androids: one SR tier, the other SSR tier. To give you a chance to get your favorite Android, there is a rotation in the market: SR Encryption Keys are rotated every month, and SSR Encryption Keys are rotated once per season.

Androids will increase your Commander's health. The value of the HP increase depends on the level of the Android. This buff applies from the moment you have an Android in your collection. Androids that are not in your squad but in your collection will buff your Commander's HP too.

You will need Android Points and Android Gold to upgrade your Android. These work in the same way as mercenary points and credits. You can find these resources on the Alliance War map or in the Alliance rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/00de3d62eb10c6dea96d1b6f3aa9970133da13bc.png

Alliance Wars will now be divided into seasons!
We're introducing seasons for the Alliance Wars, each lasting 3 months.

During the season, each player will receive temporary units in their squad: Super Twins. We have introduced new resources to upgrade them: turbo cores and red neo-cubes. These resources are earned by participating and winning in Alliance Wars.

Super Twins are much stronger than regular units, but at the end of each season, Super Twins will leave your squad. Remember that your Super Twins' levels will be reset every season.

At the end of each season, guilds receive generous rewards. The value of these rewards depends on how well the guild as a whole has performed.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/63fdf4251138a5e89079c25e486921b58a0d3a52.png

A major rebalancing
We have rebalanced guilds to give newcomers and fresh guilds a chance to prove themselves.

We have changed the War Spoils roulette. The cost per spin has been reduced from 100 to 20. Now War Spoils has the same level for all players, and all rewards for all players have been increased accordingly.

War Bonds can now be earned in the Daily Alliance War Leaderboard, as well as in the new Weekly Alliance War Leaderboard, which does not take into account the number of tiles captured but only the Influence that the Alliance has accumulated during the Alliance War.

War Bonds are no longer rewarded for capturing and holding a sector on the War Map. They are now tied to the Alliance's position in the Daily and Weekly Leaderboards. So now, if you're a fresh aspiring Alliance in a war with other fresh Alliances, you can get the same amount of War Bonds as the top guilds in the world by being at the top of your current Daily and Weekly Leaderboards.

Instead of mercenary points and microchips, the War Spoils roulette update will give you resources to boost Super Twins and Encryption Keys for Androids. Additional guild units can now be purchased with Turbo Cores instead of War Bonds currency.

We have added a seasonal Alliance War Leaderboard. This will reward Alliance members with valuable rewards once per season. The rewards include: lots of resources for upgrading Androids and resources for upgrading non-seasonal units. For example, by upgrading Super Twins and using them to win, you can massively upgrade your permanent units at the end of the season.

This update will be delivered to all players in the following hours. We hope that these updates will make Alliance Wars more dynamic and fair! Have a great battle!

Log in to the game and get your gift using the promo code: guildupdate! The gift can be activated in the profile settings under "Promotion Code" until 10:00 UTC on 04.04.2025!

notes.title: The War Update
notes.notes:
Your Alliance is under attack! Reclaim the territories! Introducing a new strategic game mode—Alliance War. Send troops to map sectors, coordinate with your Alliance to claim territories and landmarks, and earn rewards for controlling them!
🪖 Alliance War
 An Alliance War lasts for six days and consists of three daily skirmishes, totaling 18 war skirmishes. Troops can be sent in each skirmish, but each troop can only be deployed once per day. Therefore, it is important to allocate your combined forces wisely.
 The Alliance War map shows details for all tiles you can reach—this allows you to track troop changes on all tiles you can attack at a glance.
 To stay competitive with other Alliances, you can grow your troops. Use Turbo Cores and Neocubes, new resources that you can gain from Alliance events, and assign your mercenaries to your troops and boost their performance!
 Rewards in Alliance War are awarded for holding sectors. At the end of each third skirmish, you and your Alliance will receive the rewards associated with each sector under your control. The amount each player receives is proportional to the amount of troops they have contributed throughout the 3 rounds. Each player receives a percentage of each tile's reward, depending on their position in the Alliance. The rewards granted at the end of skirmish 18 (the last one) are doubled.
 Alliance War grants you War Bonds, a new resource you can spend in War Spoils to get Neocubes, Turbo Cores, Super Diesel, Legendary Merc Points, Emerix Gems, and Micro Chips. The amount of rewards is scaled with the level of the War Spoils, which increases with the number of spins.
 There are several War Tiers your Alliance may be placed on: Tier 1 receives more resources like Emerixes and Legendary Mercenaries from tiles, while Tier 2 and Tier 3 get more War Bonds.
You can learn more about Alliance War by clicking on the (i) button in the upper left corner in the Alliance War window.
🍑 General Changes
 - Added Polish language support! You can switch your game's language in the settings.
 You can now use replies to messages in chats.
 New battle backgrounds.
 Heli Race shop now available when Heli Race isn't on.
 Various bug fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: The Alliance Update
notes.notes:
Welcome, Commanders, to another major update! This one is pretty big. It's so big. Ahem, right, so, let's see what was added in The Alliance Update!
Mascot Florence DLC
As part of this update, we're releasing a new exclusive DLC with the Florence Mascot! If you weren't among the first players to play Lust Goddess, or if you weren't lucky enough to randomly receive her a couple weeks ago, this is your chance to diversify your main screen!
Read all about her on her store page
This DLC will be on a 40% discount for the first week it's out, so get in on the deal while it's hot!
Alliances

 Introducing our new social feature — Alliances. Even the best of the best need teams if they are to achieve greatness.
 Find your strength in numbers and embrace coordination. Call your friends to form new alliances or join existing ones.
 Each Alliance is made up of ordinary members, officers and leaders. Leaders are the ones who created the Alliance and have full control over it. Officers are appointed by them.
 By participating in various Alliance modes and activities, you will earn various Alliance resources, including Influence and Apex. They are now also available as a bonus in Emerix Gem Packs in the Shop. Influence and Apex are used to level up your Alliance and activate special bonuses.
Alliance Bonuses

 Speaking of bonuses, there is a handy toolbox on the Alliance main screen that takes you to a tech tree that lists Alliance bonuses.
 These bonuses include increased attack and health for mercenaries, reduced prices for modifications and level-ups, and more.
 To unlock the bonuses, you will need certain Alliance levels and some Influence. Apex is required to keep bonuses active. Bonuses activate for you only.
Heli Racing
Join forces to complete quests, outperform other teams and get the most rewards! Completing quests in Heli Racing will give you two resources: 

 Top Gears — a personal resource that allows you to purchase rewards in a special market.
 Magnetrons — an alliance resource that defines your guild's performance, giving you better rankings and rewards.
You can learn more about the Heli Racing game mode in this helpful document. Please note that Heli Racing will launch a few days after the update.
General Changes

 Alliance Chat allows you to communicate with your mates right within the game! Coordinate your strategies around Heli Racing, share tips (kinky, but you do you), or chat about whatever! Alliance owners and officers can also pin a message in this chat.
 Global Chat allows you to share your wonderful thoughts with the entire population of the game. Recruit other people or just chat about whatever!
 Direct chat messages, well… we hope you get the idea by now.
 Improved login security. Our team received some private disclosures of potential vulnerabilities in our login system, which we fixed.
 Fixed bugs that could lead to players losing their progress. If you encountered this issue, please contact our support team from the in-game settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/ddafe013ce13d87767b43566fc195847fc1e2dcb.gif

notes.title: The Relationship Update
notes.notes:
Welcome, Commanders, to our next major update! Over the past few months, our team has been thinking: how can we improve your connection to your favorite mercenaries? That's when we came up with a new relationship system. Let's see what it is and what else has been added in this update:
Relationships
We know you love DMing with our girls. But what if you could meet them, talk to them, flirt with them, share an ice cream cone, or soak in a hot tub with them? Introductions: Relationships.

 Some girls have a special Relationship meter and level. You can increase this meter by sending the right DM replies or by giving them special items.
 As a girl's relationship meter fills up, your relationship level with her increases. Each new level unlocks new bios, dates, and outfits (skins).
 Dates are a new type of reward that allows you to take your girls out on a date. It involves different storylines, interactive dialog and some very… intimate situations.
 Bio shows you more details about your favorite girls. Learn their nicknames, star signs, personality types, life facts, and more.
 Outfits are mercenary skins — and by reaching relationship level 20, you can unlock exclusive outfits for your favorite girls.
 The path to relationship level 20 is quite long. Love takes time to develop! But you can speed it up by giving gifts. Gifts come in all rarities, and certain girls have preferences for what they like and what they love. Gifts can be obtained from PvP chests, daily/weekly quests, and from special shops.
 With the release of this feature, two girls become dateable: Kitty and Regina. More will become datable with new events — including Mitsuki!

General Changes
In addition to this new system, we've made other improvements to the game.

 Updated UI for Love Chats. Now there's more focus on the conversation and your conversation partner. Also, the gallery button has been moved to a more prominent location.
 Each mercenary already has two outfits: regular and… enhanced. You can now choose between them if you prefer your mercenaries to look less revealing. This does not apply to commanders. Not yet.
 Free daily, weekly, and monthly deals are no longer available. This has been the case for new players for some time already, but is now rolled out to everyone.
 However, free rewards for contests on our Discord are now available! Join our server and keep an eye on the #community-events channel.
 Fixed a bug that would show you didn't have enough space for PvP crates when you had empty slots.
 Fixed a number of other minor localization, animation, graphics and UI issues.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869949/ce803bea3221f0a27f319a9200e9f1fc8ae165a2.png

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Having a hot game? Well we're here to deliver an even hotter experience for you! 😎

Here's our first update, bundled with bug fixes, performance improvements on some devices, and an extra-special way for you to get some more booty! Let's dive in.

General Changes

 Referrals — invite your friends to play Lust Goddess, give them a quick starting boost, and receive a ton of hot stuff when they reach certain Leagues 🥵
 When you send a referral code, your friend will need to install the game and enter it into the Promotion Code tab in their profile. Note: you can only use a referral code until you've reached League 26!
 Updated combat Stims to display their effect right on the field. Saved you a click!
 Fixed graphical bugs that could occur on some devices that rendered the game using Vulkan.
 Changed the Esc button to always bring up the "Exit the game" dialog window instead of going into windowed mode first. You can still control the fullscreen behavior in settings.
 Fixed some graphical bugs with Love Direct portraits, Commander cards in Squad, and in quests in the tutorial Roadmap.
